stem: Between 1846 and 1855 the population of Ireland decreased by a third, including the approximately 1.5 million Irish immigrants who left for the United States. What was the primary reason for this migration?

options.label: F
options.text: Massive unemployment resulting from British occupation

options.label: G
options.text: Political unrest during an economic recession

options.label: H
options.text: Famine caused by a major crop failure

options.label: J
options.text: Civil war between Catholics and Protestants
